title: Steering wheel feel and heating
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly discuss steering wheel feel, grip, and heated-wheel equipment, with praise for comfort and design alongside complaints about missing heating and some control-layout or size concerns.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the steering wheel’s feel, grip, design, and the availability or enjoyment of heated steering wheel features.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on missing heated steering wheel equipment on some trims and dissatisfaction with steering-related features.

mixed.summary: The mixed review says moving functions from steering wheel controls to the display is distracting and feels less safe while driving.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention steering wheel feel, heating, size, or complaints without enough context to confirm a clear sentiment label from the sample alone.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are very short or incomplete, which limits confidence about the exact issue or sentiment in the undetermined group.
This topic includes multiple related subtopics—steering wheel feel, heated steering wheel availability, wheel size, and steering-wheel control layout—so the cluster is somewhat broad.
The examples are sentiment-stratified samples rather than representative estimates of all reviews in the topic.
